title: pfaffia pulverulenta
intro: Pfaffia pulverulenta, commonly known as suma, is a type of succulent plant native to South America. The health benefits of Pfaffia pulverulenta include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of suma include its adaptogenic properties, which can help the body adapt to stress, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Pfaffia pulverulenta include saponins, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
